Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Daxko needs to hit target across the expanded portfolio, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how Daxko's reply rate likely compares to other software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
